mechanism_narrative: The joint recovery of TRANSIT and WORKPLACES from -29.3/-28.9 at t-3w to -2.1/-11.1 at t-0w signals restored commuting and weekday activity, which raises RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose from -29.3 to -2.1 over four weekly means
fact:WORKPLACES rose from -28.9 to -11.1 over four weekly means
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is not higher than the last 28 days despite TRANSIT and WORKPLACES continuing to recover.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM crossing above +15 percent change from baseline indicates a normalized essential-shopping routine, which spills over into discretionary retail and lifts RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM weekly mean crosses above +15 percent change from baseline
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines or stays flat over the next 14 days after GROCERY_PHARM has already crossed above +15.

mechanism_narrative: A falling RESIDENTIAL series below +6 combined with PARKS recovering above -20 indicates substitution from staying home to out-of-home activity, increasing RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls below +6 and PARKS rises above -20
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the next 14 days when RESIDENTIAL is below +6 and PARKS is above -20.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime where TRANSIT has recovered above -5, the removal of mobility restrictions directly enables retail-and-recreation trips, lifting RETAIL_REC within one week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean is above -5 percent change from baseline
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 7 days when TRANSIT is above -5.

mechanism_narrative: The seasonal transition from winter to spring in Delhi raises outdoor activity; as PARKS improves from the winter trough, associated retail-and-recreation footfall rises over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved from -37.9 at t-3w to -15.3 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is not higher than the last 28 days despite the seasonal PARKS recovery.

mechanism_narrative: Return-to-office policy easing is visible as WORKPLACES rising above -10; office repopulation increases after-work retail trips and raises RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES weekly mean crosses above -10 percent change from baseline
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise over the next 28 days after WORKPLACES crosses above -10.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM is above +10 while RETAIL_REC is still below -15, households are still in essential-only mode; as this imbalance closes, pent-up discretionary demand lifts RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM weekly mean is above +10 and RETAIL_REC weekly mean is below -15
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM was +13.0 and RETAIL_REC was -20.3 at t-1w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise over the next 14 days as the GROCERY_PHARM versus RETAIL_REC gap narrows.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS remains below -20 for two consecutive weeks, outdoor recreation constraints suppress retail-and-recreation mobility, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean remains below -20 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS was below -20 at t-2w and t-1w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days even though PARKS remained below -20 for two consecutive weeks.
